name: Ticonderoga-class cruiser (Baseline 3)
role: Aegis guided-missile cruiser for air defence, surface warfare, anti-submarine warfare and land strike

serviceWindow.statusNotes: The example ship, USS Bunker Hill (CG 52), was commissioned on 20 September 1986 and decommissioned in September 2023 (s4). The class is not gone: the Navy is keeping USS Gettysburg (CG 64), USS Chosin (CG 65) and USS Cape St. George (CG 71) in service on extended service lives running through fiscal year 2029 (s5). A small number of other Ticonderoga hulls were still in service on 2026-03-15; this record does not state an exact count because no source fetched for it gives one. The class entry stays active for that reason.

propulsionSummary: Four General Electric LM2500 gas turbines drive two shafts for about 80,000 shaft horsepower.

weapons.name: RIM-66M SM-2MR
weapons.mountSummary: Fired from the Mk 41 vertical launch system (FAS notes vertical launchers from CG 52 on); missile count is the engine's typical mix, not a published load. The Navy fact file gives SM-2 Medium Range as up to 90 nautical miles (about 167 km), so the 93 km engine range is estimated.

weapons.name: RGM-84 Harpoon
weapons.mountSummary: Two quad launchers (8 missiles). The Navy fact file gives Harpoon range as over 67 nautical miles (about 124 km), so the 139 km engine range is estimated.

weapons.name: Mk 15 Phalanx CIWS
weapons.mountSummary: 20 mm six-barrel gun, the class carries two mounts, the engine models one. FAS lists Phalanx range as classified, so range and round count are estimated.

sensors.name: AN/SPY-1A phased-array radar
sensors.role: Aegis air search and track, four fixed arrays, FAS says it tracks air contacts beyond 200 miles

sensors.name: AN/SPS-49 air search radar
sensors.role: Long-range 2D air search that backs up the SPY-1 on ships that keep it, picks out low-radar-cross-section targets in clutter and jamming

sensors.name: AN/SPG-62 fire control radars
sensors.role: Illuminates the target for semi-active SM-2 missiles in the last seconds of flight

sensors.name: AN/SQS-53 bow sonar
sensors.role: Hull-mounted active and passive search for submarines

sensors.name: AN/SQR-19 towed array
sensors.role: Passive long-range listening for submarines on a cable towed behind the ship

sensors.name: AN/SLQ-32 electronic support
sensors.role: Detects, identifies and bears on hostile radars

sensors.name: Bridge and lookout watch
sensors.role: Eyes and binoculars from the bridge and weather decks

radar.note: A 173 m hull with a tall, boxy superstructure and two large masts. It was built on the Spruance hull before radar cross-section shaping became a design goal.

infrared.note: Four gas turbines put out a strong exhaust plume, the same as on a destroyer.

acoustic.note: Gas turbine ship of about 9,600 tons. Active bow sonar adds a deliberate noise source when it pings.

visual.note: A large grey ship with a tall deckhouse and two stacks is easy to spot.

brief.whatItIs: The Ticonderoga class is the US Navy's cruiser: a 173 m Aegis warship built on the Spruance destroyer hull with a larger missile battery and more command space than a destroyer. USS Bunker Hill (CG 52) was the first ship with vertical launchers. She was decommissioned in September 2023, but the class is not retired.
brief.howItIsUsed: A commander uses a cruiser as the air-defence coordinator for a carrier group or a surface action group. The SPY-1A radar and the older SPS-49 search radar build the air picture, and the Aegis system hands targets to Standard missiles. Tomahawk missiles give it strike reach on land, and the 5-inch guns and Phalanx cover small boats and leakers. The extra command space lets a flag officer run the air defence of the whole group from this ship. Its weak points are age and magazine depth. The hulls are close to 40 years old, so material readiness varies from ship to ship, and the missile cells cannot be reloaded quickly at sea. Treat the missile counts in this record as typical.
typicalMissions: Air defence coordination for a carrier strike group
Anti-submarine escort with towed array and helicopters
